About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
About the Role
 
We are looking for a well-connected Business Development professional to grow our P2P merchant network, strengthen liquidity, and drive local market adoption across Vietnam and Indonesia.
This role is ideal for someone with established relationships in trading, fintech, or crypto communities who can turn local connections into measurable results. You will work closely with our regional team to onboard and activate merchants, support community initiatives, and grow liquidity in VND and IDR markets.

Key Responsibilities

Merchant Onboarding & Activation
  • Identify, engage, and onboard General Advertisers (GAs) and Verified Advertisers (VAs) in the VND and IDR markets.
  • Guide merchants through onboarding, ad posting, and their initial trading activity.
  • Build ongoing merchant relationships to support sustained activity and compliance with platform requirements.
Local Market Development
  • Identify grassroots opportunities to expand P2P awareness and adoption.
  • Support local meetups, community sessions, and university outreach initiatives as needed.
  • Turn local market insights and community connections into actionable growth opportunities.
KOL & P2P Education Support
  • Collaborate with local key opinion leaders (KOLs) and trading communities to drive awareness and merchant acquisition.
  • Help deliver P2P School initiatives, including training sessions, workshops, and online education.
Liquidity Growth
  • Attract high-quality Verified Advertisers, including experienced merchants from other P2P platforms.
  • Encourage consistent ad posting and sustained liquidity in VND and IDR trading pairs.
Reporting & Team Collaboration
  • Maintain lightweight daily trackers covering outreach, onboarding, activation, and liquidity contribution.
  • Participate in weekly performance calls with the regional team to review progress and priorities.
What We’re Looking For
  • Experience in business development, sales, community growth, or the crypto/P2P ecosystem.
  • A strong understanding of Southeast Asia’s P2P trading, payments, or digital asset landscape.
  • Confidence in merchant outreach, follow-ups, and relationship management.
  • The ability to work independently, deliver against clear targets, and maintain consistent reporting.
  • Fluency in English and either Vietnamese or Bahasa Indonesia, depending on the market covered.
  • An established network of merchants, traders, or crypto community contacts is a strong advantage.
Nice to Have
  • Hands-on experience with P2P exchanges or fintech platforms.
  • Experience organizing or supporting online and offline community events.
  • Active involvement in local crypto or trading communities.

 

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
